description: Election Commission - Selected Mr. H. M. S. Seneviratne as a member of the ward No. 12 Palleweliketiya of Akurana P/S
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Akurana Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member's death, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process, candidate nomination by a political party, and the formal declaration of an elected member to fill the vacancy, making it clearly fall under Elections classification.
